Requirements: R-14
Plan row: TS-17

## Given
A guest cart with two lines; route interception on the browser.

## Steps
1. Fail GET /api/cart with 500, then with no answer; open the cart page.
2. Fail GET /api/books/{bookId} with 500; open the cart page.
3. Fail PUT /api/cart/{itemId} (500, timeout); change a quantity; GET /api/cart without interception.
4. Fail DELETE /api/cart/{itemId} (500, timeout); remove a line; GET /api/cart without interception.

## Then
1. P-cartread: with the cart read failed the page shows what Q4 gives; it does not present an empty cart as the truth.
2. P-bookread: with the book read failed the cart lines show as Q4 gives.
3. P-putfail: after the failed quantity change the page and the stored quantity (read through the unintercepted GET) are as Q4 gives.
4. P-deletefail: after the failed delete the line and the message are as Q4 gives, and the stored cart still holds the line.

## Obligation coverage
| OB | part | oracle | boundary | Then | residual gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| OB-17 | read failures | Q4, Q1 norm | 500 and timeout | 1, 2 | badge read failure (AppProviders) only observed, not asserted |
| OB-17 | write failures | Q4, Q1 norm | 500 and timeout | 3, 4 | |
